description: This header file defines interfaces for trigger decoder operations in a vehicle engine management system, including functions to add trigger events and configure trigger shapes.

methods.name: addSkippedToothTriggerEvents
methods.description: Adds skipped tooth trigger events based on wheel, shape, count, offset, engine cycle, and filter parameters.

methods.name: initializeSkippedToothTriggerShapeExt
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with skipped teeth, total count, skipped count, and operation mode.

methods.name: configureOnePlus60_2
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for a specific arrangement called OnePlus60_2 based on the operation mode.

methods.name: configure3_1_cam
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for a 3-1 cam setup based on the operation mode.

methods.name: configureOnePlusOne
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for a OnePlusOne setup based on the operation mode.
